name: SWING OFF A TOWER!
desc:
⛳ How FAR can you SWING?

💡 How to play:
💵 Swing off tower to earn cash!
🏢 Buy floors and build the tallest tower!
💪 Upgrade golf club to increase power!
🏆 Become #1 and reach the furthest distance!

Can you get a hole in one?! 🎯

👍 Like the game & join the group for updates!
